# Bounded coherent HEVC reference-content observer (offline)

**AI disclosure:** This file, including its title and all prose, was generated by AI.

Implementation of the #77/PR78 observation contract for
[omarchy-m1-video#82](https://github.com/iconidentify/omarchy-m1-video/issues/82).
Parent [libva-v4l2_request#42](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/42)
stays open. No hardware, module, or shipped patch.

The first object is a **fake asynchronous queue**: pause blocks submits, drain
completes in-flight readers under a deadline, retention is explicit. Copy runs
only after that sequence. Unknown/cacheable exporters are rejected; a SYNC ioctl
is not assumed to repair them.

## Run

```
python3 experiments/hevc-reference-content/tests.py
```

Caps: 184320 bytes/snapshot, 8 snapshots. Process context only. Default off.
